pages.text: $(bold)Villagers watch you.$(br2)$(li)Take from their chests, break their things or sleep in their beds and you are $(thing)seen$(n).$(br)$(li)Crimes lower your $(thing)reputation$(n). Low enough and they refuse to trade; lower and the guards attack.
pages.title: A11. Villages
Staying Welcome
pages.text: $(bold)$(li)Gifts win them back.$(br)$(li)Small crimes fade with time; heavy ones linger.$(br2)Trading is a task at $(l:paths/trader)Trader$(n), so stay welcome.
